text_block_list.name: Kaya & Others
text_block_list.text: ORYAAAAAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text: おりゃああーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Monika & Others
text_block_list.text: SEEEEEEEEEEEEI!
text_block_list.orig_text: せええーーーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Miroc
text_block_list.text: ...Guh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ぐっ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: THIS IS... THE FINAL BLOW!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで、
トドメだっ！

text_block_list.name: Miroc
text_block_list.text: Gah, hah...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
が、
はっ……！

text_block_list.name: Jun & Others
text_block_list.text: Did I do it?!
text_block_list.orig_text: やったか！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It's settled!
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝負アリ、
だよ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Even you can't take any more hits than this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくらあなたでも、
これ以上は戦えないはずです！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: Miyako and her friends won! ...I'm so tired...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミヤコたちの勝ちなの！
……疲れたの～……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I can't take it anymore... I'm at my limit... Sunyaaa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅっ～……
もう、
ダメ……
限、
かぁい……
……すやぁ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: It seems that every single one of us has used up all our strength. ...I can no longer maintain this form either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こちらも、
一人残らず力を使い切ってしまったようじゃの。
……わらわももはや、
姿を維持できぬか。

text_block_list.name: Miroc
text_block_list.text: A vampire... A ghost... An ESPer...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……吸血鬼……
……幽霊……
……超能力者……

text_block_list.name: Miroc
text_block_list.text: Because you exist in "reality"... my thinking is being distorted. Things like you, which are beyond reason...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前たちが、
『現実』に在るせいで……
私の思考は狂わされる。
お前たちのような、
理外のものが……

text_block_list.name: Miroc
text_block_list.text: And, why... why are our souls trapped in such a biocomputer? If no one can prove it... then I... I will...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして、
何故……
魂は、
電脳に囚われた？
誰にも証明できぬというのなら……
私は……
私は……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: STOP RAMBLING ONNNNNN!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ごちゃごちゃ言ってんじゃないわよーっ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Miroc
text_block_list.text: GAHAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text: がはっ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Kyaru-chan!?
text_block_list.orig_text: キャルちゃんっ！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I don't need nor want to listen to anymore of this guy's nonsense! More importantly, we got the last Sol Orb back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなやつの戯言、
聞いてやる必要ないっての！
それよりも、
最後のソルオーブは返してもらったわよっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ah! He's running away?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！
逃げちゃう！？

text_block_list.name: Miroc
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Not... yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……
まだ……、
だ……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: That said, I fail to think of him as a threat any longer. His wounds are so severe that simply moving should prove an unmeasurable strain, his persistence must be beyond common belief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ、
もう相手にはならないだろう。
なぜ動けるのか分からないほどの深手だったし、
執念深いにもほどがあるね……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hey, more importantly, isn't it kind of... hot?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
それより。
なんだか……
暑くない？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It's been hot for a while now, but you're right that the temperature is rising... AHHHN?! Kyaru, YOUR TAIL'S ON FIRE?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきまでも暑かったけど、
ますます……
ああっ！？
キャル、
しっぽが燃えてるわよ！？

text_block_list.name: Kyaru and the others
text_block_list.text: UNYAAAAAAAAAAAH?!
text_block_list.orig_text: うにゃああああっ！？

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: I'M GOING TO BE TURNED INTO A GRILLED LIMA!
text_block_list.orig_text: 黒リマになっちゃう～っ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: There's a huge fire at the bottom, and a huge one at the top!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
下は大火事、
上も大火事です～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Because the last Sol Orb is gone... the Great God's gone berserk?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソルオーブがなくなったせいで、
巨神が暴走してるっての！？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I can't release any more cold air to help... Let's get out of here quickly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
冷気を出せない……
急いで脱出しましょう！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: うん！
